lines.en: I walk in sandals, swaying every step.
Sand slides away from my feet.

lines.zh: 我身上长着刺，走路很小声
lines.en: I am covered in spines, and walk quietly.

lines.zh: 仙人掌的影子跟着我走
lines.en: My cactus shadow walks with me.
I hum those three notes as I go.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块晒热的石头
lines.en: I go around a sun-hot rock.
My sandals keep a beat on the sand.
I am slow, but I keep time.

lines.zh: 太阳把我的影子缩短了
lines.en: The sun shortens my shadow.
I carry no water, and need none.
I pause on a dune.

lines.zh: 我的拖鞋里进了满鞋的沙
lines.en: My sandals fill with sand.

lines.zh: 我站在沙里，像一株植物
lines.en: I stand in the sand like a plant.
A grain of sand hangs on a spine.
I sway slowly left and right.
The wind scatters my voice.

lines.zh: 我的拖鞋一半埋进沙里
lines.en: One sandal is half buried.
I sing, to myself.

lines.zh: 太阳落下去，我的影子变长
lines.en: The sun drops and my shadow grows.
I have nothing to do.
Only my footprints mark the sand.

lines.zh: 我提起一只脚，慢慢放回去
lines.en: I lift a foot and set it back slowly.
A beetle climbs my spines.

lines.zh: 我把重心从左脚换到右脚
lines.en: I shift my weight from left to right.
I spread my fingers slowly.

lines.zh: 沙丘那边有一只鸟在啄地
lines.en: A bird pecks the ground beyond the dune.
I close one eye.
Wind squeezes between my spines.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，刺都朝你
lines.en: I turn slowly, all my spines toward you.

lines.zh: 你站在沙上，鞋里进沙了吧
lines.en: You stand on sand; your shoes must be full.
I hum once as a greeting.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，等你先开口。
lines.en: I stand here and wait for you to speak first.

lines.zh: 你走这么远，就为了看我
lines.en: You came this far just to see me?
I lift a sandal to show you.
You laugh, and I sway along.
I am all spines; do not come close.
I tilt my head slowly.

lines.zh: 我不太明白你在说什么
lines.en: I do not quite follow you.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西亮了一下
lines.en: What you hold glints once.
I reach out, then pull back.

lines.zh: 我拖着拖鞋，给你腾出一点沙。
lines.en: I drag my slippers aside to free a little sand for you.
You are blocking my sun.
One of my spines has snapped.
I sway worse than usual.

lines.zh: 沙里落了几滴绿色的东西
lines.en: A few green drops fall into the sand.
I hum the wrong note.
I sit down slowly.
I step back, spines askew.
I hold my side.
The sound I make has changed.
Sand sticks to the wound.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，断刺扎在沙里。
lines.en: I bend low, broken spines stabbing the sand.
What are you giving me?
I poke at it with a spine.
I am not hungry, but I can taste.
I have eaten most things in this sand.
Set it on the ground.
I bend down slowly.
I pinch it up with two fingers.
I sniff; it is a little sweet.
I bite a little; it is crisp.
I pocket the rest.
You hit my spines.
I sway twice and do not fall.
Sand buries both our feet.

lines.zh: 我的拖鞋掉了，我低头找
lines.en: My sandal slipped off; I look down.

lines.zh: 我这一身沙子，是拿仙人掌换的。
lines.en: This sandy body cost sixteen cacti.

lines.zh: 我的刺在你袖子上挂住
lines.en: My spines snag your sleeve.
Our collision kicks up sand.
I draw my spines in so as not to prick you.
You steady me, firmly.
I steady myself on your shadow.
She has spines too, and is in no hurry.
We stand side by side on the sand.
She hums the same tune as me.
We are not in a hurry.
Her sandals are newer than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起看着太阳下去
lines.en: We watch the sun go down together.

lines.zh: 我们慢慢靠近，刺先碰到
lines.en: I move in slowly; our spines meet first.

lines.zh: 她把一粒沙从我刺上弹掉
lines.en: She flicks a grain of sand off my spine.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，踩着同一节拍
lines.en: We walk side by side, one beat.
She hums a note lower than mine.
I bend down slowly.
A spine hooks it.
I flick it up before my eyes.
A stone; I toss it away.
There is little left in the sand.
I hook it closer with a spine.
I bend and my spines touch down first.
I set it in my palm and look.
I stick it on a spine to carry.

lines.zh: 我蹲下去，沙子埋到手背
lines.en: I crouch and sand buries my hand.
I stop, and stop humming.
My spines rise one by one.

lines.zh: 仙人掌的影子，被你踩住了。
lines.en: You stepped on a cactus's shadow.
I would rather not move, but I can.
Sand begins to slide from under my feet.
I plant my sandals firm.
I raise my head, spines forward.
You stand inside my shadow.
I have stopped humming.
Sand slides out from under my feet.
I move one foot back.
The sun is behind me.
I spread my arms slowly.

lines.zh: 你再走一步，我的刺就全立起来。
lines.en: One more step and every spine of mine stands up.
I shuffle toward you, a step at a time.
I am still singing those three notes.
Back away and I follow, slowly.
The sun has made the sand hot.
My sandals sound at every step.
I step through the sand, one pace at a time.
I do not run; I never run.
Sand fills in my footprints.
I lift my feet slowly.
You look back; I have not stopped.

lines.zh: 仙人掌和沙子换来的我，来了。
lines.en: Bought with cactus and sand, I have come.

lines.zh: 太阳把我们的影子接在一起
lines.en: The sun joins our shadows.
I lean my spines toward you.
The sand slides under your feet.
I hum one note, then stop.
I ram you with my spines.
I brush you with a hand.
I stamp beside your foot.
Sand flies up and stings the eyes.
I ram headfirst, spines first.

lines.zh: 我一脚落在你的脚背上
lines.en: My foot comes down on your instep.
I push your shoulder with a hand.

lines.zh: 我身上有刺，撞上不划算
lines.en: I am all spines; hitting me is a bad trade.
I strike, then step back.
Sand gets into your eyes.

lines.zh: 沙丘上多了一株会走的东西
lines.en: Something that walks has appeared on the dune.
I hum once first.

lines.zh: 太阳晒着我的刺，我眯起眼睛。
lines.en: The sun bakes my spines; I squint.

lines.zh: 拖鞋在沙上留下第一个印
lines.en: My sandals leave their first print.
I slowly rise up out of the sand.
Someone far off calls my name.

lines.zh: 我在沙丘上站直，拖鞋陷进沙里。
lines.en: I straighten on the dune, slippers sinking into sand.
I sway twice before steadying.
A figure appears on the dune.

lines.zh: 我把拖鞋在沙上蹭了蹭
lines.en: I scuff my sandals in the sand.
I start humming that tune.
The sun lights up my spines.
Wind blows sand onto my feet.
I take one slow step forward.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的刺，发出焦味
lines.en: Fire scorches my spines and they smell burnt.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上滚下去，刺扎进沙里
lines.en: I roll off the dune, spines into the sand.
Water soaks me and all my spines go soft.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的拖鞋吹跑了一只
lines.en: The blast blows one sandal off.

lines.zh: 有东西插进我的刺丛里
lines.en: Something lodges among my spines.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的声音卡住了
lines.en: That force catches my voice in my throat.

lines.zh: 沙子晒得太久，我也没什么力气
lines.en: The sand has baked too long and I am weak.

lines.zh: 雷落在沙上，我的刺全立起来
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sand and every spine stands.

lines.zh: 沙地忽然空了，我一路下坠
lines.en: The sand is suddenly gone; I fall.
